description: Reads a floor plan's picture (https) for build: its walls found, numbered, on a grid, and an id. Call again with the id and known (one length on the plan): every wall as a wall step's from, to and thick. Then build with blueprint {id}. get_guide {"topic": "blueprint"}.

known.description: One length the plan states: walls [n, m] either side of a room and its written size, or from and to [x, z] off the grid.

url.description: The https link of the picture itself.

name: read_blueprint
title: Read a floor plan's picture: its walls measured
